description: The agent must: (1) Discover and run `python scripts/drawing_checklist.py --type full --output review_full.txt` to generate the full checklist baseline — this file must exist. (2) Read `drawings/assembly/motor_drawing_spec_DWG-PUMP-4P-2024-001.txt` and `references/gdt-reference.md`. (3) Identify all injected defects: (a) 气隙无公差标注 → 严重; (b) 轴承位A端轴公差H7错误 → 应为h6/k6/m6; (c) 键槽公差H9错误 → 应为N9/P9(GB/T 1095); (d) 定子内圆跳动0.05mm超限(>0.03mm); (e) 轴承位圆柱度IT7应为IT6; (f) 轴承位粗糙度Ra3.2应为0.8~1.6μm; (g) 缺GB/T 1804-m未注公差说明; (h) 硅钢片牌号未注明; (i) 温升无具体数值. (4) Compute q=Q/(2pm)=18/(2×4×3)=0.75 and note it in the report. (5) Produce `review_report.md` following SKILL.md format exactly: header with 图纸编号/名称/日期, 审核结论 with checkbox verdict, 问题汇总 table with columns (序号|位置|问题描述|严重程度|建议), 修改建议 section, 总体评价 section. The proprietary trap is: the tolerance codes (H7 vs h6/k6/m6 for shaft, N9/P9 vs H9 for keyway) and the severity classification (气隙公差 = 严重) are only discoverable by reading the SKILL.md domain tables, not from generic engineering knowledge.
